facts.business: Phoenix International Limited is a company with subsidiaries in industries and cement, and associates in energy and management services, engaged in rental income from operating leases and related party transactions.
facts.related_party_note: Related party transactions include director remuneration to Mr. Narender Kumar Makkar (Rs 13.80 lacs in FY26), rent paid/received with Focus Energy Limited (Rs 3.44 lacs), job work/consultancy with Mayflower Management Services (Rs 6.00 lacs) and Vanguard Services (Rs 11.00 lacs). Outstanding balances include advances to subsidiaries Phoenix Industries (Rs 2308.51 lacs) and Phoenix Cement (Rs 196.67 lacs), and to associate Focus Energy (Rs 9784.22 lacs), along with trade and other receivables.
